title: A 'closed' projection reaching Waiting throws ArgumentError in markExternalTerminal and leaves Waiting dead
description: RideStatus.closed is terminal but not a completed surface (core/contracts/ride_status.dart:59-89). In _onLiveTick (417-418) it goes to _queueStageNavigation, then _drainStageNavigation (532-533) calls _handleExternalTerminal. That path sets _leaving=true, disposes tracking, and calls _ride.markExternalTerminal(closed) at line 589. markExternalTerminal (active_ride_controller.dart:337-347) explicitly throws ArgumentError for closed. The future is unawaited, so the error is unhandled. Waiting stays mounted with tracking stopped, no terminal sheet, no navigation and no snapshot clear. RideSession.backendReconcile says projections may jump on reconnect (ride_session.dart:140-143, e.g. 'driverArriving -> paymentFinalized'), and _afterCompletion maps completed + captured + rating submitted/skipped to closed (trip_status.dart:186-190). So an in-trip Waiting that resyncs after the trip was settled and rated, or after the rating window was skipped, gets this status.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:417 `if (status.isTerminal && !status.isCompletedSurface) { _queueStageNavigation(status);`
waiting_for_driver.dart:589 `await _ride.markExternalTerminal(status);`
active_ride_controller.dart:338-346 `if (!status.isTerminal || status.isCompletedSurface || status == RideStatus.cancelledByRider || status == RideStatus.closed) { throw ArgumentError.value(...`
failure_scenario: I reproduced this with a throwaway widget test: snapshot plus session at tripInProgress, then MockRideRealtime.emit(RideStatus.closed). Result: 'ArgumentError: Invalid argument (status): Expected a non-rider external terminal status.' thrown from markExternalTerminal <- _handleExternalTerminal:589 <- _drainStageNavigation:533 <- _onLiveTick:418, and WaitingForDriver was still mounted afterwards. The rider is stuck on a frozen in-trip screen whose stored snapshot is never cleared.
suggested_fix: Route closed (and other post-trip statuses) to the completion surface or Home without calling markExternalTerminal, e.g. treat closed like a completed surface in _onLiveTick/_drainStageNavigation, or close the ride via closeCompletedRide.

title: A trip that ends in paymentFailed is cleared without a History record or receipt; the rider is told only 'the trip is not active'
description: paymentFailed is a post-completion state: the trip was driven and completed, and the payment failed (trip_status.dart:183). Waiting treats it as an external terminal (waiting_for_driver.dart:417, 589-595). markExternalTerminal archives only the cancel/no-show/failed statuses, then always runs _store.clear(). So a completed trip whose payment failed is not archived to the device History and gets no completion or receipt screen. The rider sees the generic 'Payment could not be completed ... The trip is not active' sheet and lands on Home. The trip they took is no longer visible anywhere on the device.
evidence:
active_ride_controller.dart:353-361 `if (status == RideStatus.cancelledByDriver || ... || status == RideStatus.tripFailed) { await _archive(snapshot, status, expectedRideId: id); } await _store.clear();` (paymentFailed is not in the list)
waiting_for_driver.dart:589-595 `await _ride.markExternalTerminal(status); ... RideNavigator.home(context, status: status);`
failure_scenario: I reproduced this with a throwaway widget test: an in-trip Waiting with a stored snapshot, then MockRideRealtime.emit(RideStatus.paymentFailed). Afterwards OnDemandRideHistoryStore.read() had length 0 and RideSnapshotStore.read() was null. The rider is driven to the destination and the payment fails, then the ride vanishes: no History entry, no receipt, no way to retry payment.
suggested_fix: Archive paymentFailed (it is a completed trip) before clearing, and/or route it to the completion surface that can show the payment problem.

title: A queued on-board End trip that the outbox later delivers is committed as a plain cancel, with no ended-early receipt or rating
description: If the rider taps End trip on board while the server cannot be reached, markCancelled returns pendingRetry and queues an end_early command in the outbox (active_ride_controller.dart:207-211). The outbox flush later sends it. The server applies end_early, which moves the trip to cancelled_by_rider (trip_transitions.dart:103-104) and charges the distance fare. Realtime then reports cancelledByRider to Waiting. _handleExternalTerminal takes the cancelledByRider branch and calls completeServerConfirmedCancel(), which calls _commitCancelled with no endedEarly. As a result: LastCompletedRide.remember is skipped, the History record has endedEarly:false and no charged amount, and RideNavigator.home is called. UI-01 says an on-board end 'is a finished trip with a receipt, not a silent return to Home' (waiting_for_driver.dart:860-862), and R-O6 says the rider rates an ended-early trip on the trip-end screen. Neither happens here. Nothing in Waiting listens for the outbox's `sent` outcome; it only listens for refused/stale.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:570-576 `if (status == RideStatus.cancelledByRider && widget.onTerminal == null) { await _ride.completeServerConfirmedCancel(); ... RideNavigator.home(context); return; }`
active_ride_controller.dart:159-161 `Future<void> completeServerConfirmedCancel() async { await _commitCancelled(AppScope.instance.ride.rideId); }`
failure_scenario: The rider is in the car with a flaky connection and taps End trip. They see 'couldn't reach Movera ... we'll retry'. The connection returns, the queued end-early is accepted and the rider is charged for the distance. The app then jumps straight to Home: no ended-early summary, no fare, no rating, and History shows a plain 'Cancelled' ride with no charge.
suggested_fix: When committing a server-confirmed cancelledByRider, check the outbox entry or the last in-trip stage. If it was end_early, build an EndedEarlyTrip (fare from the projection) and open the ended-early summary as the direct path does.

title: Terminal and completion events that arrive while a cancel or end-early request is in flight are dropped, not deferred; Waiting stays live on an ended trip after a rejected or pendingRetry outcome
description: _confirmCancel sets _leaving=true (820) while it awaits _ride.markCancelled, which can take two network attempts. During that time _onLiveTick sends terminal statuses to _queueStageNavigation, and that returns before it stores _pendingStageStatus (515). _maybeOpenCompleted also returns early (542). If the server then answers rejected (409: 'the ride already ended — realtime reports the real outcome', active_ride_controller.dart:256-259) or the call ends as pendingRetry, _confirmCancel resets _leaving=false (848-851). Nothing replays the swallowed status. A terminal status gets no further events, so nothing ever navigates. Only the 'stale' outcome triggers a resync (923-936); 'rejected' does not.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:515 `if (!mounted || _leaving || _completedOpened) return;
    _pendingStageStatus = status;`
waiting_for_driver.dart:542 `if (!mounted || _leaving || _completedOpened) return;`
waiting_for_driver.dart:847-852 `if (result != RideCancelOutcome.confirmed) { setState(() { _cancelling = false; _leaving = false; }); _showCancelProblem(result); return; }`
failure_scenario: On board, the rider taps End trip just as the driver completes the trip. tripCompleted arrives on realtime while the POST is in flight and is ignored. The server answers 409 invalid_transition, so the outcome is rejected. The rider sees 'This ride can no longer be cancelled' and stays on the Waiting screen with the trip ended and no completion screen. The same happens with noShow or cancelledByAdmin during an in-flight cancel.
suggested_fix: Store the status in _pendingStageStatus even while _leaving, and drain it (or re-check _tracking.status) after a non-confirmed cancel outcome. Alternatively, resync on rejected as is done for stale.

title: After a reload, the server's waiting.arrivedAt and acceptedAt are thrown away, so the waiting fee clock restarts on every rebuild and the cancel-fee preview counts from reload time
description: DriverTrackingController applies event.acceptedAt and event.waitingArrivedAt only inside `if (accepted)` (driver_tracking_controller.dart:127-145). A restore seeds the session with the snapshot's version (ride_restore_coordinator.dart:312-326), and tracking saves the latest version into the snapshot. The first projection after a reload therefore usually has the same version and status, and backendReconcile rejects it as a duplicate (ride_session.dart:168-173). So waitingSince and acceptedAt stay null although the projection carries them. Waiting then passes `since: _tracking.waitingSince ?? DateTime.now()` to WaitingFeeCounter. That value is recomputed on every Waiting rebuild (sheet settle, measurement, signature change), so the free-wait countdown restarts each time and never reaches the fee. The cancel-fee preview falls back to _shownAt (759), which is the reload time, although the server sent acceptedAt. The comment at 752-754 accepts that fallback only when 'the projection has no acceptedAt'.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:321-322 `return WaitingFeeCounter( since: _tracking.waitingSince ?? DateTime.now(),`
waiting_for_driver.dart:759 `DateTime get _acceptedAt => _tracking.acceptedAt ?? _shownAt;`
driver_tracking_controller.dart:127-145 `if (accepted) { ... acceptedAt = event.acceptedAt ?? acceptedAt; if (event.waitingArrivedAt != null) { waitingSince = event.waitingArrivedAt; }`
failure_scenario: I reproduced this with a throwaway widget test: snapshot version 5 at driverWaiting with category economy, session reconciled at version 5, then mock emit(driverWaiting, sequence: 5), which carries waitingArrivedAt. WaitingFeeCounter.since was 01:39:30.719. After one Waiting rebuild it was 01:39:32.013, so it moved by 1.29 s and equals 'now' on each build. A rider who reloads while the driver waits sees 'free waiting 5:00 left' reset each time the sheet moves while the server is already charging. The cancel sheet may also say 'free for N more minutes' when a fee applies.
suggested_fix: Apply acceptedAt and waitingArrivedAt (timestamps from the server) even when the status part of a same-version event is not accepted. At minimum, compute the WaitingFeeCounter fallback once and keep it, rather than DateTime.now() on each build.

title: In-trip road route and Ride check planned route go straight from driver to destination and ignore booked stops, causing false off-route alerts on multi-stop trips
description: _routeEndpoints for the in-trip stage returns only driver to destination (2334-2346), and _refreshRoadRoute asks roadRoutePolyline for that single leg. The resulting points are passed to RideCheckController.setPlannedRoute through onTripRoute (2386-2390 -> 1474-1481). RideCheckMonitor keeps the first route (setPlannedRoute without replace) and fires offRoute when a fix is more than offRouteKm (default 2 km) from it (ride_check_monitor.dart:98-102, 212-220). When the driver goes to a booked stop more than about 2 km off the direct line, as they are supposed to, the safety Ride check fires an 'off route' alert. The rider-facing polyline also skips the stop.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:2334-2346 `if (_inTrip) { return ( from: driverPoint ?? ..., to: GeoPoint(widget.destinationPosition.latitude, ...` 
waiting_for_driver.dart:2386-2390 `if (_inTrip && !approximate) { widget.onTripRoute?.call([...route.points...]);`
ride_check_monitor.dart:212-216 `final off = distanceToPolyline(sample.point, route); if (off <= settings.offRouteKm * 1000) return null; return _fire(RideCheckTrigger.offRoute, ...`
failure_scenario: A trip from Södermalm to Solna with a stop in Bromma. Once on board, the planned route is the direct Södermalm to Solna road line. The driver heads to Bromma, more than 2 km from that line, and the Ride check card asks the rider if they are OK because the car is 'off route'. The map also draws a route that bypasses the stop.
suggested_fix: Route the in-trip leg through the remaining stops (or concatenate per-leg road routes) before showing it and handing it to Ride check, or do not set a planned route when the trip has stops.

title: Safety Kit row on the Waiting sheet uses the on-demand session's rideId, not the screen's ride, so SOS, share and recording target no ride or the wrong one on scheduled live rides
description: WaitingNotesAndPin builds SafetyKitSheetRow with AppScope.instance.ride.rideId. The rest of Waiting uses _rideId, which is widget.rideId ?? session.rideId (for example SafetyKitMapButton(rideId: _rideId) at waiting_for_driver.dart:1503). ReservationLiveRide.pageFor passes rideId: reservationId with its own realtime, while the on-demand session holds null or a previous on-demand ride. From the sheet row, RideSafetyKitSheet then calls _ctl.sos(rideId: null), which returns false (not registered), startShare(''), and audio.start(rideId: 'ride_local'). It could also use a stale on-demand ride id.
evidence:
waiting_sheet_bits.dart:550 `SafetyKitSheetRow(rideId: AppScope.instance.ride.rideId),`
waiting_for_driver.dart:1503 `SafetyKitMapButton(rideId: _rideId),`
safety_controller.dart:143-145 `Future<bool> sos({String? rideId}) async { final id = rideId?.trim(); if (id == null || id.isEmpty) return false;`
failure_scenario: On a scheduled ride's live screen, the rider opens Safety Kit from the row in the sheet and taps SOS. The SOS is not registered with the trip (sos returns false). Trip share starts for an empty ride id. The same actions from the map button work.
suggested_fix: Pass the screen's ride id into WaitingNotesAndPin (rideId: _rideId) and use it for SafetyKitSheetRow.

title: In-trip 'Arrive by HH:MM' on the sheet freezes because the rebuild signature ignores ETA changes during the trip
description: _onLiveTick rebuilds only when _sheetSignatureFor changes. That signature uses eta.headline() and eta.subtitle(), which return the constant 'Ride in progress' and 'to drop-off' copy during the trip (driver_eta.dart:99-101, 117-121). The sheet headline and RiderInTripPanel headline come from _tripHeadline, computed from eta.seconds at build time (1665-1669). So an ETA change during the trip never rebuilds the sheet, and its arrival time stays at the value from the last rebuild. The map's destination time pin does update (paintIfDue -> _syncTimePins), so the map and the sheet disagree.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:430-432 `if (signature == _sheetSignature) return; _sheetSignature = signature; setState(() {});`
waiting_for_driver.dart:440-443 `final headline = eta?.headline(status: status) ?? ...; return '${status.name}|$headline|$subtitle|${driver?.id ?? ''}'`
waiting_for_driver.dart:1668 `return context.l10n.arriveBy(clockTime(DateTime.now().add(Duration(seconds: seconds))));`
failure_scenario: I reproduced this with a throwaway widget test: an in-trip Waiting, emit with etaSeconds 600 shows 'Arrive by 01:47'. A later fix with etaSeconds 3600 still showed 'Arrive by 01:47' (expected about 02:37). The rider stuck in traffic is told they will arrive 50 minutes earlier than the live ETA.
suggested_fix: Include the in-trip arrival minute (or eta.seconds rounded to a minute) in _sheetSignatureFor.

title: Route change and 'change destination instead' are offered on scheduled live rides but can never succeed
description: _routeEditable depends only on tracking status, so the ⋯ buttons (_openDetails) and the cancel sheet's offerDestinationChange are enabled for ReservationLiveRide pages too. _currentRide() builds a RideSnapshot whose rideId is the local reservation id. RouteChangeController.preview then posts /api/v1/rides/<reservationId>/route-quote. Reservations are device-local (LocalReservationRepository), so the server has no such ride and answers 404, which _send maps to RouteChangeFailure.network ('route update failed'). The rider is offered an action that always fails, with a misleading network error, and the map is parked and rebuilt each time.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:1004 `bool get _routeEditable => !_tracking.status.isTerminal && !_completedOpened;`
waiting_for_driver.dart:811 `offerDestinationChange: _routeEditable,`
route_change_controller.dart:199-203 `_api.post('/api/v1/rides/$id/route-quote', ...`
in_process_mock_client.dart:817-820 `final ride = rides[parts[4]]; if (ride == null) { status = 404;`
failure_scenario: During a scheduled ride the rider taps 'Change destination instead' on the cancel sheet, picks a new address and taps See new price. The result is always 'couldn't update the route' and the ride continues unchanged.
suggested_fix: Disable route editing when widget.realtime/onCancel indicate a reservation-backed page, or route it through the reservation controller.

title: After Retry on the 'can't track ride' screen, Ride check is never attached, the waiting terms are never loaded and the known stage is not seeded
description: initState attaches Ride check (attachTrip), starts the long-stop timer and loads the waiting terms only when a rideId exists at mount (265-277). When rideId is missing, _missingRideId is set. _retryTracking later starts tracking once a rideId is available, but it does not call attachTrip, _startRideCheckStillTimer or _loadWaitingTerms, and it omits initialStatus: _knownStatus(rideId). The ride then runs without the Ride check safety monitor and without the waiting fee counter. Until the first accepted event it shows the driverAssigned default even if the session knows the ride is in trip.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:362-371 `void _retryTracking() { ... setState(() => _missingRideId = false); _tracking.start( rideId: rideId, initial: widget.driver, onChange: _onLiveTick, ); }`
waiting_for_driver.dart:272-277 `RideCheckController.shared.attachTrip(...); _startRideCheckStillTimer(rideId.trim()); unawaited(_loadWaitingTerms());` (only in initState)
failure_scenario: Waiting mounts before the session's rideId is set, so 'We can't track this ride' is shown. The rider taps Retry and the live ride appears. Ride check never monitors the trip (no long-stop or off-route alerts), and no waiting fee counter appears when the driver arrives.
suggested_fix: Share one 'begin tracking' helper between initState and _retryTracking that does attachTrip, the still timer, _loadWaitingTerms and initialStatus.

title: After the map is parked and rebuilt (route change), the driver marker is missing until the next realtime tick
description: _changeRoute parks the map, which removes _WaitingRideMap, and then rebuilds it. The new _WaitingRideMapState builds its markers in initState and _prepareMapVisuals using _currentDriverPosition(), and that reads _driverAnimTo. _driverAnimTo is filled only by _updateDriverAnimation from paintIfDue, which runs only on the next _onLiveTick. The tracking controller already holds the driver's last fix (tracking.eta), but the new map does not use it. If the feed is quiet (driver standing at the pickup with no new fix), the car stays off the map.
evidence:
waiting_for_driver.dart:2028-2033 `void initState() { super.initState(); _markers = _buildMarkers(); unawaited(_prepareMapVisuals()); }`
waiting_for_driver.dart:2270 `final driverPosition = _currentDriverPosition();` (null until paintIfDue)
failure_scenario: The driver is waiting at the pickup and the rider changes the destination. When the route sheet closes, the map shows pickup and destination but no car until the driver's app sends another fix.
suggested_fix: Seed the animation from widget.tracking.eta in initState (call _updateDriverAnimation, or paintIfDue after the first frame).

title: Route change differences under 0.5 major units are shown as 'Same price' and skip the payment confirmation, though the new total differs
description: The sheet treats |newPrice − oldPrice| < 0.5 as no change: the copy says 'Same price', the struck-through old price is hidden and the payment step is skipped. In EUR or TND zones (Q7: the trip's currency), fares have cents or millimes, so a real change of, for example, 0.40 € is presented as the same price. apply() still sends expectedTotalMinor = the new total, and the server charges the difference. The same threshold hides the difference in showRouteUpdated (route_change_flow.dart:185).
evidence:
route_change_sheet.dart:93 `if (_cash || _diff.abs() < 0.5) { Navigator.pop(context, const RouteChangeDecision(confirmed: true));`
route_change_sheet.dart:125-126 `if (diff.abs() < 0.5) { priceNote = context.l10n.samePrice;`
failure_scenario: In Paris (EUR) the rider moves the destination slightly. The quote goes from 18.20 € to 18.60 €. The sheet says 'Same price' next to 18.60 € and confirms with no payment step, and the card is charged 0.40 € more.
suggested_fix: Compare minor units (newTotalMinor vs the booked total in minor units) and treat any non-zero difference as a change.

title: Book now can submit the generic 'Card' method with no saved card when the rider picks Card from the payment row on Set pickup, skipping Add card
description: _bookNow checks the 'card must be saved first' rule only once, before Set pickup opens (line 1463: `if (payment.brand == 'cards' && !_selection.hasSavedCard) { AddCardPage.open ... }`). Set pickup has its own payment row (onChangePayment: _showPaymentPicker, line 1318). PayWithPage lists the generic 'cards' row while the rider has no saved card (pay_with_page.dart:199), and _showPaymentPicker selects it. After Set pickup returns, _bookNow re-reads the selected method (lines 1491-1498) and passes it straight to submitFinding(paymentMethod: payment.brand) at line 1540. It never runs the Add card check again. The booking goes out with paymentMethodId 'cards', and there is no card behind it.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:1463 `if (payment.brand == 'cards' && !_selection.hasSavedCard) {`
select_ride.dart:1491-1498 `final chosen = _selection.selectedPaymentItem(); if (chosen != null) { payment = _PaymentOption(brand: chosen.brand, ...` 
select_ride.dart:1540 `paymentMethod: payment.brand,`
Reproduced with a throwaway widget test (CardEntryPolicy on, no saved cards): Select Movera -> on Set pickup tap the 'Cash' payment row -> PayWith 'pay-with-cards' -> Confirm. Output: `AUDIT payments=[apple, google, cards, cash] selected=cash hasCard=false` / `AUDIT submits=1 paymentMethod=cards hasCard=false`.
failure_scenario: A rider with no saved card taps Select Movera, then taps the payment line on Set pickup and picks 'Card', then confirms. The ride is booked and Finding opens with payment 'Card', but no card was ever entered, so nothing can be charged. Choosing Card on Select Ride itself would have opened Add card first.
suggested_fix: After Set pickup returns, run the same `brand == 'cards' && !hasSavedCard` check (open Add card, or refuse) before submitFinding. Or have _showPaymentPicker open Add card when the generic Card row is picked.

title: Book for later books a moved pickup at the old pickup's price: it never waits for the pin re-quote still in flight and never checks the price shown
description: In the scheduled path, Set pickup re-prices the moved pin through onRequote -> _requoteFromPin -> _selection.quoteFromPin. Set pickup's _confirm waits at most confirmWait (3 s) for that re-quote, while the quote timeout is 8 s. Book now covers a late answer: _quoteAfterPickup awaits `_pinQuote` and _acceptNewPrice compares the result with spot.fareTotalKr. _bookScheduled does neither. Right after Set pickup returns, it calls ScheduledRideCheckout.run, which reads ScheduledRideBooking.quotedPrice -> selection.authoritativePriceFor(...) synchronously. At that moment authoritativeQuotes still holds the quote for the original pickup. The reservation is created with the moved pickup's coordinates and the original point's price. The pin quote is adopted a moment later, which is too late. The same thing happens when the pin re-quote fails.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:1132-1141 `final spot = await _openSetPickup(...); ... _pickupPosition = spot.position; _pickupConfirmed = true;` then 1153-1176 `created = await ScheduledRideCheckout.run(context, ..., selection: _selection, pickup: ReservationPlace(label: _pickupAddress, lat: _pickupPosition.latitude, ...` with no `await _pinQuote` and no comparison with `spot.fareTotalKr` (compare _bookNow 1501-1520).
scheduled_ride_booking.dart:26 `final price = selection.authoritativePriceFor(categoryId, now: now);`
Reproduced (slow pin quote, scheduled SelectRide): move the pin, confirm 'Confirm and schedule'. Output: `AUDIT reservations=1 price=259.0 pickupLat=59.31147893000034` then `AUDIT selection price after pin lands=301.0`.
failure_scenario: On a slow network, the rider schedules a ride, drags the pickup pin to another street and taps Confirm and schedule within 3 s. The reservation is saved at the old pickup's quote (259 kr) even though its pickup is the new point, whose server quote is 301 kr. The rider is never shown the new price.
suggested_fix: Use the same path as Book now: reset _pinQuote/_pinQuoteAdopted before Set pickup, await _quoteAfterPickup(ride) after it, and ask _acceptNewPrice when the booked total differs from spot.fareTotalKr before calling ScheduledRideCheckout.run.

title: Cancelling Set pickup in Book for later after the pin was re-priced keeps the pin's price, and the next Schedule books it at the original pickup
description: When the rider backs out of Set pickup after a pin quote was adopted, Book now reloads the list quotes (line 1484: `if (_pinQuoteAdopted) unawaited(_loadQuotes());`) because 'the pin's price belongs to a point the rider did not confirm'. The scheduled path just returns (line 1137: `if (spot == null || !mounted) return;`). It never resets or checks _pinQuoteAdopted, so the selection keeps the moved pin's quote as the authoritative price at the unchanged original pickup. On the next Schedule tap, Set pickup opens at the original point and shows that price. Confirming without moving the pin creates the reservation at the moved pin's price for the original pickup.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:1137 `if (spot == null || !mounted) return;` (scheduled)
select_ride.dart:1482-1485 `if (spot == null) { // The pin's price belongs to a point the rider did not confirm. if (_pinQuoteAdopted) unawaited(_loadQuotes()); return; }` (Book now only)
Reproduced: scheduled SelectRide, move the pin (quote 301), pop Set pickup, tap Schedule again, confirm without moving. Output: `AUDIT after cancel: price=301.0` / `AUDIT reservation price=301.0 pickupLat=59.3293` (the original pickup, whose quote is 259).
failure_scenario: A rider scheduling a ride drags the pin toward the airport terminal, then changes their mind and goes back. The Movera row now shows 301 kr for the original pickup. Tapping Schedule and confirming at the original point saves a reservation priced 301 kr instead of the 259 kr quote for that point.
suggested_fix: In _bookScheduled, reset _pinQuote/_pinQuoteAdopted before opening Set pickup and reload quotes when Set pickup is cancelled after a pin quote, as _bookNow does.

title: Backing out of Set pickup while the pin re-quote is in flight lets the late pin quote overwrite the original pickup's price, and the next Book now books it
description: The reload on cancel is guarded by `_pinQuoteAdopted`, which _requoteFromPin sets only after its quote lands (line 512). quoteFromPin is not cancelled when Set pickup closes; only cancelPendingQuotes on SelectRide's own pop or dispose does that. So if the rider backs out while the pin re-quote is still pending, line 1484 sees false and skips the reload. The pin quote then lands and adoptQuote stores the moved point's price as the authoritative quote for the unchanged pickup. On the next Book tap, Set pickup opens at the original point and shows that price. _quoteAfterPickup then finds a 'bookable' quote and the prices match, so the ride is booked at the moved pin's price for the original pickup.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:510-512 `final quote = await pending; if (quote == null || !mounted) return null; _pinQuoteAdopted = true;`
select_ride.dart:1484 `if (_pinQuoteAdopted) unawaited(_loadQuotes());`
ride_selection_controller.dart:445-446 `if (_disposed || generation != _pinQuoteGeneration) return null; adoptQuote(rideId, quote);`
Reproduced: move the pin (slow quote), pop Set pickup, let the quote land, tap Select Movera again and confirm. Output: `AUDIT after back+late pin: economy=301.0` / `AUDIT booked price=301.0 lat=59.3293 submits=1`.
failure_scenario: On a slow connection, the rider nudges the pickup pin, then backs out of Set pickup within the quote latency. Two seconds later the Movera row on Select Ride shows the moved point's price. Booking from the original pickup charges that price instead of the original pickup's own quote.
suggested_fix: On cancel, invalidate any pending pin quote (bump _pinQuoteGeneration, or cancel it) and reload list quotes when a pin re-quote was started, not only when it was already adopted.

title: When a quote expires or fails, the ride row silently falls back to the static catalog list price and nothing re-quotes
description: priceFor discards an expired quote (_discardExpiredQuote removes offeredPrices and authoritativeQuotes) and returns `offeredPrices[id] ?? catalog`. A failed quote (_loadQuote catch) also removes offeredPrices. _hasPrice is true for any list price in the pickup's currency, so _rideTile shows the catalog price (e.g. 259 kr for every Movera trip, whatever the distance) as the fare. It is not marked as an estimate or as unavailable. Nothing schedules a re-quote at expiry. The next rebuild (sheet drag, tapping a row) simply swaps the quoted fare for the list price. The rider learns that there is no price only when Book answers 'price unavailable, refreshing'. DECISIONS P4: 'Clients display a quote; they do not invent totals.'
evidence:
ride_selection_controller.dart:498-501 `double priceFor(String id, double catalog, {DateTime? now}) { _discardExpiredQuote(id, now: now); return offeredPrices[id] ?? catalog; }`
ride_selection_controller.dart:524-525 `offeredPrices.containsKey(id) || catalogCurrency == currency;`
select_ride.dart:2304 `_hasPrice(ride) ? _kr(price) : '…',`
Reproduced with 2-second quotes of 412 kr: fresh `412kr=5 259kr=0`; after expiry plus one rebuild `412kr=0 259kr=1 calls=14 available=false` (no new quote requests).
failure_scenario: The rider looks at Select Ride for more than the quote lifetime (2 min in the mock) on an Arlanda trip quoted at 412 kr. Dragging the sheet changes every row to its list price (Movera 259 kr, Comfort 339 kr ...), which looks like a price drop. Tapping Book then says the price is unavailable and re-prices.
suggested_fix: Show '…' or 'updating' for ids in unavailableQuoteIds or with an expired quote instead of the catalog price, and schedule a re-quote shortly before quoteExpiresAt.

title: A quote in another currency drops the wallet row and shifts the index-based payment choice to a different method
description: The chosen payment is held as an index into payments() (selectedPayment, line 114). payments() includes the wallet row only while walletMatchesTrip holds (line 267). Every other list change re-selects by brand: setWalletBalance, setZonePaymentMethods and loadSavedCards all do. adoptQuote changes `currency = quote.currency` without that. When the server prices the pickup in a currency other than the RiderZones guess (the controller explicitly supports this: 'the server decides'), walletMatchesTrip turns false and the wallet row, which is first in the list, disappears. Every index then points one row further down, so the selected method silently becomes a different one. This is separate from the known finding about prices mixing currencies.
evidence:
ride_selection_controller.dart:114 `int selectedPayment = 1;`
ride_selection_controller.dart:265-268 `if (item.brand == 'wallet') { return _flags.enableWallet && walletBalance > 0 && walletMatchesTrip; }`
ride_selection_controller.dart:457 `currency = quote.currency;` (no selectPaymentByBrand afterwards)
Reproduced in a unit test: wallet balance 50 SEK, select 'cards', adopt a EUR quote. Output: `AUDIT payment before=cards after=cash list=[google, cards, cash]`.
failure_scenario: A rider with wallet credit picks Card. The quote comes back in EUR, so the wallet row disappears and the payment line switches to Cash without the rider touching it. Book then sends paymentMethod 'cash'.
suggested_fix: In the currency setter (or adoptQuote), remember the selected brand before the change and call selectPaymentByBrand(brand) afterwards. Better still, store the selection as a brand instead of an index.

title: Editing a reservation, or planning a return ride, paid with Movera Wallet silently switches the method to Cash when saved cards finish loading before the wallet balance
description: initState calls selectPaymentNamed(paymentName) and then _loadSavedCards(paymentName), which re-applies the name after the cards load (line 406). The wallet row exists only once walletBalance > 0, which _loadWalletBalance sets in a separate future (two awaits). If the cards load first, 'Movera Wallet' is not in payments(). selectPaymentNamed finds nothing and leaves the constructor default (Cash), and setWalletBalance later re-selects that current brand (cash). The reservation's stored payment is lost. In the edit flow, ReviewChanges then saves Cash. This has the same root race as the known restoreDefaultPayment finding, but on the explicit initialPaymentMethod / editingReservationId path.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:347-353 `final paymentName = widget.initialPaymentMethod ?? ... _reservations.byId(...)?.paymentMethod; _selection.selectPaymentNamed(paymentName); unawaited(_loadSavedCards(paymentName));`
select_ride.dart:404-406 `await _selection.loadSavedCards(); if (paymentName != null) { _selection.selectPaymentNamed(paymentName);`
ride_selection_controller.dart:598-601 `final current = selectedPaymentItem()?.brand; walletBalance = balance; if (current != null) selectPaymentByBrand(current);`
failure_scenario: The rider edits a scheduled ride that was booked with Movera Wallet. Select Ride opens with Cash selected, Review changes lists the payment change to Cash, and saving the edit stores Cash.
suggested_fix: Re-apply the requested payment name (or brand) after the wallet balance has loaded too, for example by awaiting both loads before resolving the initial method.

title: Select Ride stays interactive during the Home lookup before Set pickup opens, so category, payment and booking-mode taps race the booking already captured
description: _bookNow captures `selected` and `payment`, parks the map, and _openSetPickup then awaits _homePosition() (saved-places hydrate up to 600 ms plus a Home geocode up to 900 ms) before pushing Set pickup. During that window only the Book CTA is disabled (_bookingInFlight). Ride tiles (_selectRide, line 2187), the payment row (_showPaymentPicker) and the calendar button (_showBookingPicker) still respond. A tap on another category highlights it, but Set pickup and the booking use the captured one. A tap on Pay with or the calendar pushes that page or sheet, and Set pickup then opens on top of it.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:1280 `final home = await _homePosition();`
select_ride.dart:1262-1267 `.timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 600)) ... .timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 900));`
select_ride.dart:2187 `onTap: () => _selectRide(ride.id),` and 2520 `onTap: _showBookingPicker,` (no _bookingInFlight check)
failure_scenario: A rider with Home saved taps Select Movera, then immediately taps Comfort. Comfort is highlighted on Select Ride, but Set pickup and the booking are for Movera. Or they tap the calendar and a 'When do you want to ride' sheet stays under Set pickup and Finding.
suggested_fix: Ignore row, payment and booking-mode taps while _bookingInFlight, or resolve Home before setting the lock and capturing the selection.

title: The 'Price updated' dialog has no time limit, so a quote that expires while it is open fails the booking with a generic error after the rider accepted
description: _bookableQuote guarantees only 10 s of quote life (_quoteMargin) before _acceptNewPrice opens. The dialog waits for the rider indefinitely, and the quote is not re-checked or refreshed after they accept. Mock quotes live 2 minutes. If the rider takes longer, BookingCoordinator refuses the expired quote locally (booking_coordinator.dart:630) and the rider sees 'bookingFailed' right after tapping 'Book for X'.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:532 `static const _quoteMargin = Duration(seconds: 10);`
select_ride.dart:1515-1520 `if (shown != null && ... != quote.totalMinor && !await _acceptNewPrice(shown, authoritativePrice)) {...}` followed directly by submitFinding with `quote.expiresAt` (1543)
booking_coordinator.dart:630 `(!isReplay && !quoteExpiresAt.isAfter(DateTime.now())) ||`
failure_scenario: After moving the pin, the rider gets 'Price updated: 301 kr', leaves the phone for a couple of minutes, comes back and taps 'Book for 301 kr'. They are told the booking failed and must start again.
suggested_fix: After the dialog, re-run _bookableQuote (refreshing via _quoteAfterPickup if needed) and ask again only if the refreshed price differs.

title: A catalog answer that changes the category ids while Set pickup is open starts a list re-quote at the unconfirmed original pickup that can overwrite the pin's quote
description: _onCatalogChanged runs _loadQuotes() whenever the ids differ (for example, the server list replacing the 14 built-in ids on first use). _loadQuotes prices every category at _pickupPosition, which is still the original point while Set pickup is open. RIDE-11 protects the pin quote only from list loads begun before it (quoteFromPin bumps _quoteGeneration). A list load begun after the pin quote is adopted overwrites the selected category's authoritative quote with the original point's price. Book now then shows a 'price updated' dialog asking the rider to accept the original pickup's price for the moved pickup.
evidence:
select_ride.dart:435 `if (!sameIds) unawaited(_loadQuotes());`
select_ride.dart:475-480 `distanceMeters: straightLineMeters(_pickupPosition, ...), pickupPoint: _geoPoint(_pickupPosition),`
ride_selection_controller.dart:401-402 `if (generation != _quoteGeneration) return; adoptQuote(rideId, quote);`
failure_scenario: On a slow first launch, the ride-types answer lands while the rider is on Set pickup with the pin already moved and re-priced. The selected ride's quote reverts to the original point's price, and the booking dialog proposes that wrong price for the moved pickup.
suggested_fix: Defer catalog-triggered re-quotes while the booking flow (_bookingInFlight / Set pickup) is open, or skip overwriting a quote adopted from a pin after the list load began.

title: Book-for-later stops are priced and charged but never stored on the reservation
description: The comment on lines 50-54 says stops in Book for later are a 'U5 stopgap', 'silently dropped' because 'ReservationDraft has no stops', and must stay 'Hidden until multi-stop quoting, routing and booking exist end to end'. The kill switch is set to true anyway, so the Add a stop button and stop fields are shown. The trace: ScheduleRide._syncRouteToSession copies the stops into ScheduledRideSession.stops. openScheduledCategorySelector passes them to SelectRide(stops: List<String>.from(session.stops)) (scheduled_category_gate.dart:52). SelectRide._loadQuotes includes them in the quote ('Quotes include the stops (audit finding B7)', select_ride.dart:466-471). ScheduledRideBooking.confirm then books at that stop-inclusive quotedPrice, but the ReservationDraft and ReservationPatch it builds have no stops field (scheduled_ride_booking.dart:62-96; reservation.dart:132-162). Reservation.toJson never writes stops, and ReservationLiveRide.pageFor passes no stops to WaitingForDriver. So the rider pays for a multi-stop route, while the stored reservation, the live trip and the driver only know pickup to destination.
failure_scenario: The rider opens Book for later, adds Stop 1 'Odenplan' and picks a time. On the category cards the price includes the stop (for example 289 kr instead of 229 kr), and they tap Schedule. The reservation is saved at 289 kr with no stop. Upcoming, History and the live ride show only A to B, and the driver drives straight to the destination.
suggested_fix: Set _stopsSupported back to false (as the comment requires) until ReservationDraft, Reservation and the live ride carry stops. Otherwise, add stops to the reservation model and pass them through.

title: startLiveIfDue acts on a stale snapshot and can turn a cancelled reservation back into an assigned one
description: startLiveIfDue reads `upcoming()` once and then awaits a store write for each ride. It decides what to do from the old `listed` copy and never checks the ride again. LocalReservationRepository.assignDriver and updateReservation run in order (_oneAtATime), but they have no status guard. They copy the new status over whatever is stored now, even a cancelled ride. If a rider's cancel is in flight (the storage write has not finished) when the Home chrono's 30-second tick runs, `upcoming()` still lists the ride as scheduled. The tick queues assignMockDriver after the cancel, and that runs `current.copyWith(status: driverAssigned, driver: ...)` on the cancelled record. The same applies to the T-2 `_store.assignDriver(id)` (back to driverAssignmentPending) and the en-route `updateReservation`. The rider is told the ride is cancelled, then it reappears as upcoming with a driver while cancelledAt, cancellationReason and the fee are still set. Reproduced with a throwaway test (slow storage write, cancel started, then startLiveIfDue): status after cancel+tick was ReservationStatus.driverAssigned, driver=Elin, cancelledAt=2026-10-21 09:01:00.000Z.
failure_scenario: The rider cancels a scheduled ride while the Home chrono tick is running. The cancel sheet closes and the ride shows as cancelled for a moment, then it is back in Upcoming with 'Driver assigned'. At T-2 min it goes en route and the live screen opens for a ride the rider cancelled.
suggested_fix: In the repository's assignDriver and update paths, re-read the current record and refuse (or skip) when its status is no longer upcoming or is not the expected 'from' status. Alternatively, re-fetch byId(ride.reservationId) inside the loop before each mutation.

title: Ending a scheduled ride on board is recorded as a plain rider cancel, with no end-early flag, fare or summary
description: WaitingForDriver._confirmCancel opens the cancel sheet with CancelPhase.inTrip while the trip is in progress. For Book now, the end-early path records the trip as ended early and opens the receipt (UI-01). For a reservation, widget.onCancel is set, so the custom handler runs instead, and it only calls reservations.cancel(id, reason) and popUntil Home. LocalReservationRepository.cancelReservation never sets endedEarly or chargedFare, although the Reservation model has both fields for exactly this case ('UI-01: the rider ended the trip on board (contract end_early)'). The pre-confirm note even tells the rider the booked price applies to the whole trip (bookedPriceWholeTrip).
failure_scenario: During an in-progress scheduled ride, the rider taps End trip and confirms. The app jumps to Home with no summary. History lists the ride as 'Cancelled' (not 'Ended early') at the full booked price, and the reservation record looks as if it was cancelled before the trip.
suggested_fix: When the reservation is inProgress, record an end-early (endedEarly: true plus the fare) and route to the ended-early summary instead of a plain cancel.

title: Reservation cancel reason codes 'no_driver_found' and 'rider_cancelled_live' show as raw English text
description: The controller records no-driver cancels with the code 'no_driver_found' (ReservationController.noDriverFoundReason), and the live screen records 'rider_cancelled_live'. reasonLabel only maps CancellationReason ids and the _reasonLabels table, which has 'system_no_driver' but not these two codes. Both fall through to the snake_case prettifier, so they show as untranslated English in the reservation status body (resBodyCancelledReason) and in the History detail 'Reason:' line. Verified with a throwaway test in fr: reasonLabel('no_driver_found') returned 'No driver found' and reasonLabel('rider_cancelled_live') returned 'Rider cancelled live'.
failure_scenario: A French rider resolves a 'No driver found' reservation. The cancelled reservation reads 'Annulée. No driver found', and History shows 'Motif : No driver found'. A ride cancelled from the live screen shows 'Rider cancelled live' in every language.
suggested_fix: Map 'no_driver_found' to termNoDriverFound and 'rider_cancelled_live' to a translated label in _reasonLabels, or record 'system_no_driver' instead.

title: Continue becomes disabled when the picked slot goes past the minimum lead time, so the auto-correction never runs
description: _goNext has a branch that moves an illegal pickup to the next legal slot and shows 'pickup time updated'. But _continueButton disables the button whenever isLegalPickup is false at build time. If the rider stays on the screen past the slot boundary (the minimum moves on about every minute, because roundToFive rounds now+30 up) and anything rebuilds the screen (switching Pickup at / Arrive by, a resize or a keyboard change), Continue turns grey. No message appears and the old time is still shown. The correction path can only be reached if no rebuild happened after the boundary.
failure_scenario: The rider opens the picker at 09:29 with 10:00 selected, waits, and at 09:31 taps 'Arrive by' and then 'Pickup at'. Continue goes grey with no explanation while 10:00 is still shown. They have to guess that they must pick the time again.
suggested_fix: Keep the button enabled (apart from _continuing) and let _goNext do the correction, or clamp the time and show the message during build/tick when the selection becomes illegal.

title: ScheduleDateTimeSelector.choose moves the initial time to a legal slot before initState, so 'pickup time updated' is never shown
description: choose() calls session.captureSchedule(initial), which already runs clampPickup. initState then compares clampPickup(existing) with existing, and both are the already clamped value, so _pickupCorrectionMessage is never set. SelectRide relies on this picker for return-ride prefills ('opens on the prefill clamped to the next legal slot'). The rider's return time can be moved (for example 21:07 to 21:10, or a past time to now+30) with no notice.
failure_scenario: A return ride is prefilled at origin+3h = 21:07, which is off the 5-minute grid. The picker opens at 21:10 with no 'pickup time updated' line, so the rider does not know the time was changed.
suggested_fix: Pass the raw initial time to the selector (for example a separate field), or compare against the unclamped value.

title: Live scheduled ride rebuilds the ride notes by substring search: '3+ bags' is lost and free text sets the wrong flags
description: notesOf turns the stored note string back into RideNotes with note.contains('Bags'|'Pet'|'Baby'|'Child'). manyBags is never set, so a 'Bags 3+' booking shows as 1-2 bags on the live screen. Any free text that contains those substrings sets the flags. The note holds the rider's own words joined with ' · ' (SelectRide._driverNote), so 'Petra meets you' sets pet and 'Child seat in my bag' sets child.
failure_scenario: A rider books for later with 3+ bags and a note 'Petra will meet the driver'. The live ride sheet shows 'Bags' (not 3+) and a Pet chip, and the driver-facing summary is wrong.
evidence:
reservation_live_ride.dart:34-41:
    final note = ride.note ?? '';
    return RideNotes(
      bags: note.contains('Bags'),
      pet: note.contains('Pet'),
      baby: note.contains('Baby'),
      child: note.contains('Child'),
suggested_fix: Split on ' · ' and ', ' and match the exact labels from RideNotes.selected, including 'Bags 3+'. Better, store RideNotes structurally on the reservation.

title: Scheduled live ride offers route/destination changes that always fail with 404
description: pageFor reuses WaitingForDriver and does not turn off route editing. _routeEditable is true until the ride ends, so the three-dots route screen and the cancel sheet's 'change destination' offer are shown. RouteChangeController then posts to /api/v1/rides/{rideId}/route-quote with the reservation id (rsv_...). The API has no such ride: the in-process mock answers 404 not_found when rides[id] is null. The rider is offered an edit that cannot work, and a successful local change would never reach the reservation record anyway.
failure_scenario: During a scheduled ride with the driver en route, the rider opens ride details and changes the destination. Pricing the change fails (404), or in the cancel sheet they choose 'change destination' instead of cancelling and get an error.
suggested_fix: Add a WaitingForDriver flag to turn off route changes for reservation live rides, or route reservation edits through ReservationController.

title: Driver card screen-reader label hard-codes English 'plate'
description: The Semantics label of ReservationDriverCard joins the translated driver line with the literal 'plate ${driver.plate}'. In fr and sv, screen readers announce the English word.
failure_scenario: With VoiceOver in Swedish, the upcoming reservation's driver card is read as '... Svart Volvo XC40, plate ABC 123'.
suggested_fix: Use a translated 'plate {plate}' string.

title: Chrono screen-reader label says 'Reservation in Now' at and after pickup time
description: remainingCompact returns L10n.now ('Now', 'Maintenant', 'Nu') when less than 60 s are left or the pickup time has passed, for example while the driver is en route or arrived. That word is put into reservationIn ('Reservation in {time}', 'Réservation dans {time}'), which gives a broken sentence.
failure_scenario: The driver has arrived and pickup time has passed. The VoiceOver label of the Home chrono reads 'Reservation in Now' (fr: 'Réservation dans Maintenant').
evidence:
home_reservation_chrono.dart:253-255: label: noDriver ? context.l10n.chronoNoDriverLabel : context.l10n.reservationIn(compact),
reservation_format.dart:99-100: final left = when.difference(now ?? DateTime.now()); if (left.inSeconds < 60) return L10n.current.now;
suggested_fix: Use a separate 'Reservation now' label when the time left is under a minute.

title: 'Things to know' cancellation line keeps saying 'free until …' after the free window has closed
description: The cancellation summary is worked out from cancelTermsFor(ride) at build time. UpcomingReservationPage only rebuilds when the ReservationController notifies, and nothing rebuilds it on a timer. While the rider stays on the page past freeUntil, it still says cancelling is free until HH:mm. The cancel sheet works out fresh terms, so the fee does appear before confirming.
failure_scenario: At 08:50 the rider opens a reservation for 10:00 (free until 09:00) and keeps the page open. At 09:05 it still reads 'Free until 09:00, then 50 kr', and the fee only shows once they tap Cancel.
evidence:
upcoming_reservation.dart:438-442:
                  _KnowCard(
                    waiting: policy.waitingSummary,
                    cancellation: ReservationFormat.cancellationSummary(
                      _reservations.cancelTermsFor(ride),
                    ),
suggested_fix: Rebuild when freeUntil passes (a one-shot Timer), or word the line without the live 'until' state.

title: Location Services turned off then back on from Settings leaves Home showing 'live' while the GPS stream is dead for good
description: startTracking's onError cancels the position subscription and does not resubscribe when the error is LocationServiceDisabledException or PermissionDeniedException; it only sets the state. The notice then offers 'Open settings'. When the rider turns services back on and returns, Home.didChangeAppLifecycleState(resumed) calls resumeLiveUpdates() -> _refreshAfterResume(), which takes one fix with latestFix(), sets the state to HomeLocationState.live (so accessIssue becomes null and the notice and its Retry disappear) and calls onFix once. Home's own recovery branch runs only when the state is temporarilyUnavailable (home.dart:256). The state is still servicesDisabled at that point, and _currentLatLng is non-null, so neither recoverLiveLocation nor _detectCurrentAddress runs. Nothing calls startTracking again.
failure_scenario: The rider has a live puck on Home, turns off Location Services, taps 'Open settings' on the notice, turns them back on and returns. The notice disappears and the puck jumps once, then freezes. The rider walks away, but the puck, the pickup label (_refreshPickupLabelIfMoved) and the heading from GPS course never update again until Home is rebuilt. No Retry button is left to fix it.
suggested_fix: In _refreshAfterResume (or in Home's resume branch), restart tracking when _positionSub is null, e.g. call startTracking(isMounted, onFix) whenever the stream is not subscribed instead of only taking one fix. Or treat servicesDisabled/permissionRequired like temporarilyUnavailable on resume.

title: Resume-recovery after a failed first fix tracks GPS but never draws the puck, never moves the camera and keeps 'Location off, set pickup'
description: If the first detectCurrent() throws (the 16 s detectFixTimeout or a platform error), the controller state is temporarilyUnavailable and _runDetectCurrentAddress returns after setting _pickupAddress = locationOffPickupLabel. It never reaches _prepareLocationPuckIcons, bindLiveLocation or the camera move. On the next app resume Home calls _locationCtl.recoverLiveLocation(...), which only starts the position stream. Its onFix sets _currentLatLng and calls _updateLocationVisuals(), which returns early because _locationPuckCompact/_locationPuckExpanded are still null. _refreshPickupLabelIfMoved sees _pickupLabelAt == null, stores the fix and returns, so the label stays 'Location off, set pickup'. The pulse and compass are never started and the camera stays on the default Stockholm view.
failure_scenario: On the web, the first GPS fix takes longer than 16 s (indoors), then the rider switches tabs and comes back. The location stream now delivers fixes and the recenter button appears, but no rider puck is ever painted. The map stays on central Stockholm, and the pickup still reads 'Location off, set pickup' although location works.
suggested_fix: On a recovered first fix, run the same first-fix work as _runDetectCurrentAddress: prepare the puck icons, bind pulse and heading, set the pickup label/_pickupLabelAt and do a follow camera move. Or simply call _detectCurrentAddress() when no fix has ever been bound.

title: Tapping a saved place prices and books the previous route's stops, which the rider never added in this flow
description: _useSavedPlaceAsDestination opens SelectRide with stops: List<String>.from(_routeStops). _routeStops is whatever the last Where to flow left. It is cleared in _withParkedHomeMap only when a ride changed and reached a terminal or completed state, and nothing clears it when the rider backs out of SelectRide without booking. SelectRide quotes include the stops (select_ride.dart:466-471, 'Quotes include the stops'), and Set pickup shows 'via ...'. So a one-tap saved-place booking silently carries stops from an earlier abandoned route.
failure_scenario: The rider plans Home -> stop 'Odenplan' -> 'Arlanda', looks at the prices and backs out to Home. Later they tap the 'Work' chip. SelectRide quotes Work via Odenplan (an extra stop and detour in the price), and Set pickup shows 'via Odenplan'. If they book, the trip carries a stop they never asked for.
suggested_fix: A saved-place destination starts a new route: pass const [] (or clear _routeStops) in _useSavedPlaceAsDestination. Also clear _routeStops when a flow ends without a booking.

title: Choose-on-map sends the shortened or translated field text, so Home geocodes the GPS or placeholder pickup and opens the picker at the wrong point (or a confirmable fallback)
description: The pickup field shows _show(widget.pickupAddress), which is compactAddress(...). That function both shortens the geocoder address and runs L10n.place, which translates 'Current location' and 'Location off, set pickup'. _finish undoes this with _expand(...), but _pickOnMap passes the raw display text. Home._openPickupMapPicker decides 'typedByRider' by comparing that text with the stored English, full _pickupAddress. The comparison fails, so Home forward-geocodes it (U6 says only text the rider typed may be geocoded). It also skips the fresh-fix refresh (refreshCurrentLocation: chosen == null). In fr/sv the translated location-off label is not recognised as a placeholder, so chosen becomes the geocoder's hit and positionIsFallback becomes false.
failure_scenario: First case: an English rider with a GPS pickup whose label is a long geocoder address taps the map badge. The picker opens at the forward-geocode of the short label instead of at GPS, and does not take a fresh fix. In the in-process demo the mock geocoder hashes unknown text to a made-up point near central Stockholm. Second case: a Swedish rider with location off ('Platsen är avstängd, ange upphämtning') taps it. The picker opens at a geocoded point with Confirm already enabled, contrary to D-002.
suggested_fix: Pass _expand(_activeController.text) (and the current _pickupPoint) to onPickOnMap. In Home, open at the picker's known point when one is given.

title: Confirm tapped while the map is still gliding books the new pin point with the previous street and the previous fare
description: onCameraMove updates _center continuously, but _addressIsStale, the resolve and the requote are only started in _onCameraIdle. If Confirm is tapped after the finger lifts but before the camera settles (a fling's deceleration), _resolving and _requoting are both false, so nothing is awaited. _addressIsStale is still false, so the address booked is the old street, and fareTotalKr is the old pin's fare, while position is the new _center. The method's own contract (RIDE-12) says the street and the fare confirmed are the pin's own.
failure_scenario: The rider flings the map 400 m up the street and taps 'Confirm and search' while it is still sliding. The ride is booked at the new point but labelled with the original street ('Drottninggatan 5'), and SetPickupResult.fareTotalKr is the old pin's price. The driver is sent to the wrong-named address and the price-change check compares against the wrong total.
suggested_fix: In _confirm, treat _moving (or _isAwayFrom(_center, _routeStart)) as pending: mark the address stale and wait for the next idle, resolve and requote. Or disable Confirm while the camera moves.

title: Confirm pickup spot confirms the new pin point with the previous spot's address while the pin is moving or its lookup is pending
description: onCameraMove sets _center on every frame, but _address is only replaced when _idle's reverse lookup answers. _confirmPosition has no _moving check and no 'address is stale' state. It pops ConfirmPickupResult(position: _center, address: confirmedPickupAddress(_address, ...)), where _address still names wherever the pin was before. This differs from the known _idle finding, which is about a superseded null overwriting the label: here no lookup has answered at all.
failure_scenario: On Where to, the rider uses 'Set pickup on map', drags the pin two blocks and taps Confirm before the reverse geocode returns (up to the 8 s request timeout). The route picker gets the new coordinates labelled with the old street, and that label is what the pickup shows from then on.
suggested_fix: Mark the address stale on onCameraMove. On confirm with a stale address, use droppedPinPickupAddress(_center) or wait briefly for the lookup, as SetPickupPage does.

title: Confirm pickup spot's address search and 'Use current location' land without checking whether the rider moved the pin meanwhile
description: _lookup awaits _pickup.search(query) (a network forward geocode) and then unconditionally sets _center, _address and animates the camera to the result. A pin the rider dragged in the meantime is yanked back. This is the same defect already reported for SetPickupPage._searchAddress, but in a different screen. _useCurrentLocation, after the camera move, awaits reverse(position) and writes the GPS street into _address without the _isAwayFrom(position) check that _refreshCurrentFix uses (line 175), so a pin dragged during the lookup gets the GPS street as its label.
failure_scenario: First case: the rider searches 'Odenplan', the lookup is slow, and they drag the map to a corner they can see instead. The result arrives, the map jumps back to Odenplan, and the rider's own spot is lost. Second case: the rider taps 'Use current location' and immediately nudges the pin across the road. The late reverse result labels the nudged pin with the GPS street.
suggested_fix: Record a generation or the pin position before each await, and drop the result when the pin has moved (_isAwayFrom), as _refreshCurrentFix already does.

title: Pickup 'My location' / 'Use current location' has no Dart-side timeout; on the web it can hang for about 4 hours (D-003)
description: geolocator_web 4.1.4 passes timeLimit.inMicroseconds as the JS geolocation timeout (html_geolocation_manager.dart:36), so the 15 s limit becomes about 4.2 h. The code records this as D-003 and requires an explicit Dart-side .timeout wherever getCurrentPosition is used (home_controller.dart:393-403, 614-622). PickupMapController.currentPosition calls location.getCurrentPosition with only timeLimit, and LocationRepository adds no timeout. SetPickupPage._useCurrentLocation (line 631) and ConfirmPickupSpot._useCurrentLocation (line 241) await it directly; only _refreshCurrentFix wraps it in .timeout(10 s).
failure_scenario: On the web demo, the rider taps the My location button on Set pickup where the browser cannot get a high-accuracy fix (indoors, desktop). Nothing happens: no glide, and no 'location unavailable' snackbar, because the failure branch is never reached. A later answer (if any) glides the pin away from wherever the rider has put it since.
suggested_fix: Add .timeout(...) inside PickupMapController.currentPosition (mapped to PickupLocationFailure.unavailable), and drop a late result when the pin has moved since the tap.

title: A destination chosen on the map is named 'Pickup location' whenever its street cannot be resolved
description: Home reuses ConfirmPickupSpot for 'Choose destination on map' (home.dart:756-767, title confirmDestination). Both the idle lookup and the confirm step fall back to pickupLocationFallbackLabel ('Pickup location') when the reverse geocode gives nothing usable. The initial label for an empty destination is 'Current location', which confirmedPickupAddress also maps to 'Pickup location'. The route picker then puts that text into the destination field, and SelectRide and the booking carry a destination called 'Pickup location'. The in-process transport always answers reverse-geocode with 'Current location' (in_process_mock_client.dart:332), so every map-chosen destination gets this name outside the web OSM fallback.
failure_scenario: The rider picks a drop-off on the map in an area the geocoder cannot name, or offline, or in the native demo. Plan your ride, Select ride and the trip all show the destination as 'Pickup location'.
suggested_fix: Give ConfirmPickupSpot a fallback label parameter (e.g. a dropped-pin label or 'Destination') and use it for destination picks.

title: 'Location off, set pickup' is not treated as an unusable label, so a pickup with a real GPS point is shown as 'Location off' on Select ride
description: isUnusablePickupLabel only rejects empty text, 'current location' and raw coordinates. bookingPickupAddress therefore returns locationOffPickupLabel unchanged instead of reverse-geocoding the real position. Home reaches it with a real fix in two ways. (1) The first detect failed or was denied, and the fix arrives later through _awaitCurrentFix: _prefillPickup keeps address: clean, the old placeholder, at home.dart:811. (2) The recover path above. SelectRide then opens with pickupAddress 'Location off, set pickup' (translated by L10n.place) and pickupIsFallback false. Set pickup later re-resolves it because its own _isPlaceholder covers 'location off', but Select ride, and the pickup Home remembers in _pickupAddress, say location is off while it works.
failure_scenario: The rider denies location, then allows it in the browser and taps Where to -> a destination. _awaitCurrentFix gets a fix, but Select ride shows the pickup as 'Location off, set pickup' next to a map centred on their real position.
suggested_fix: Treat locationOffPickupLabel (isPlaceholderPickupLabel) as unusable in isUnusablePickupLabel/bookingPickupAddress so a real point is reverse-geocoded.

title: Set pickup can stay on 'Finding the address…' forever when the pin returns near its last rest point during a lookup
description: _resolveAddressNow returns early when the pin moved during the lookup (_isAwayFrom(at, _center)) without clearing _resolving, and relies on a later resolve to reset it. A later resolve is only started by _onCameraIdle when _center is more than about 15 m from _routeStart, and _routeStart is that same 'at' point. If the rider drags away while the lookup is running and lets go within about 15 m of where it started, no new resolve runs. _resolving stays true and the card subtitle reads 'Finding the address…' with no lookup running. _addressIsStale also stays true, so Confirm books a dropped-pin label although the street was known.
failure_scenario: The rider moves the pin, and while its street loads they nudge the map again and let it settle back on almost the same spot. The pickup card keeps saying 'Finding the address…' indefinitely, and the confirmed pickup is 'Dropped pin · …' instead of the street.
suggested_fix: Reset _resolving (and re-run the lookup for the current point) instead of returning silently when the pin moved.

title: Home binds GPS, pulse and compass timers after it may have been disposed (no mounted check after awaiting the puck icons)
description: _runDetectCurrentAddress awaits _prepareLocationPuckIcons() (picture rasterisation, which spans frames) and then calls _locationCtl.bindLiveLocation without re-checking mounted. If Home is disposed in that window, for example when the restore coordinator replaces the root on cold start, startTracking subscribes to the position stream on an already disposed controller. That subscription is never cancelled and keeps GPS on. startPulse and startHeading create periodic timers (850 ms and 100/250 ms) that are never cancelled, and _startCompass runs again after dispose() stopped it. A later stream error calls _setState -> notifyListeners on a disposed ChangeNotifier. The new ui.Images are also kept on the dead State.
failure_scenario: On a cold start that restores a ride, Home is built, its first fix lands, and the root is replaced while the puck bitmaps are still being drawn. The rider is on the ride screen, but a dead Home location subscription and two periodic timers keep running for the rest of the session.
suggested_fix: Check `if (!mounted) return;` after `await _prepareLocationPuckIcons()`. Make bindLiveLocation/startTracking/startPulse no-ops after the controller is disposed.

title: CurvedAnimations created in build leak a status listener on _lift/_sheet on every rebuild
description: _PickupPin.build creates a new CurvedAnimation(parent: lift, ...) on every build, and _reveal creates one on _sheet for each of four sections on every build of SetPickupPage. In Flutter 3.47 the CurvedAnimation constructor calls parent.addStatusListener(_updateCurveDirection), which is removed only by dispose() (animations.dart:392/441). Its docs say 'Do not recreate it on every build as it would leak'. SetPickupPage rebuilds on every spot load, address resolve, requote, glide and bags tap, so the listeners and the CurvedAnimations they retain pile up for the page's lifetime.
failure_scenario: A rider who adjusts the pin many times on Set pickup triggers dozens of rebuilds. Each one adds five status listeners to the two controllers, so every pin lift and sheet status change has to iterate an ever-growing listener list, and leak tracking reports undisposed CurvedAnimations.
suggested_fix: Create the CurvedAnimations once (in initState, or in a StatefulWidget for _PickupPin) and dispose them.

title: Backing out of Plan your ride while it is preparing a Book for later route still opens the date picker over Home
description: RoutePickerPage has no PopScope while _finishing. On Android, system back pops it while onFinish (_confirmRouteSelection) is still running, which can take up to 8 s in _awaitCurrentFix or the destination geocode. _confirmRouteSelection checks only Home's mounted and then pushes ScheduleDateTimeSelector.choose(context, ...) from Home's context. The picker is gone and _showRouteAddressPicker already returned with a null draft, so any time chosen there is thrown away.
failure_scenario: The rider taps Book for later, picks a destination, and while the spinner shows (waiting for a first GPS fix) presses Back to leave. A few seconds later the date and time picker pops up over Home, and choosing a time does nothing.
suggested_fix: Pass a cancellation or 'still open' check from the route picker to onFinish (or block pop while _finishing), and stop _confirmRouteSelection when the picker is gone.

title: After a reload, a Ride check whose alert failed comes back as 'Movera safety team alerted', and closing it sends alert:false, so the team is never alerted
description: resume() rebuilds the card from the saved event. It sets alertState to `sent` only when the payload has an alertId, and to `none` otherwise. It never restores `failed`. If the rider called 112 (or tapped a red row), the alert POST failed (offline), and the app was then reloaded or killed and reopened, the event is still `acknowledged`, so unanswered() returns it. The answers contain call112, so `called112` is true, but alertState is `none`. _MainStep shows _AlertBanner whenever called112 is true, and _AlertBanner maps `RideCheckAlertState.none` to the success copy (ride_check_card.dart:909). The retry tap is also gone, because retryAlert needs `failed`. When the rider then taps Done or I'm OK, _close submits with `alert: closing.alertState != RideCheckAlertState.none` (line 697), which is false. The server only alerts on alert==true or an existing alert, so no alert is ever created. The red-row case behaves the same: after a reload the failed red-row alert is silently dropped on close.
evidence:
ride_check_controller.dart:449-455
      alertId: alertId is String ? alertId : null,
      alertState: alertId is String
          ? RideCheckAlertState.sent
          : RideCheckAlertState.none,
      called112: record.answers.any(...call112),
ride_check_card.dart:908-912
      RideCheckAlertState.sent || RideCheckAlertState.none => (
        context.l10n.rcAlertSentTitle,   // "Movera safety team alerted"
        context.l10n.rcAlertSentBody,    // "Trip, driver and rider details were sent."
ride_check_controller.dart:697  alert: closing.alertState != RideCheckAlertState.none,
failure_scenario: Reproduced with a throwaway test. Open a long-stop card, make POST /safety/ridecheck/answers fail, tap Call 112: alertState=failed. Rebuild the store and controller over the same device cache (a reload) and call resume('r1'): called112=true, alertState=none, and the card shows 'Movera safety team alerted · Trip, driver and rider details were sent.' Tap Done: the final submission has alert=false, final=true, and the server holds 0 alerts. A rider in danger is told help was alerted when it was not.
suggested_fix: Persist the alert intent and state, for example `alertPending: true` on the event when an alert is required and not yet confirmed. On resume, restore `failed` when the answers include call112 or a red row and there is no alertId. Never map `none` to the 'alerted' copy. In _close, compute `alert` from the answers (call112 or any red row), not from alertState.

title: Share trip goes only to the stored tripShareContactIds when that list is non-empty: deleted or disabled contacts get the link and contacts marked 'Share trips' are left out
description: Two sources of truth decide who receives a shared trip: `preferences.tripShareContactIds` (set by the Trip share checkboxes) and `EmergencyContact.shareTrips` (set by the checkbox and by the contact editor's 'Share trips' switch). The Trip share page shows a contact as checked if either is set (trip_share_page.dart:150-154), and the Safety Kit guard accepts either (ride_safety_kit.dart:214-217). startShare, however, passes `preferences.tripShareContactIds` whenever it is non-empty. The store then uses those ids verbatim, without checking that they still exist or are enabled (safety_store.dart:257-258). Nothing removes an id from that list when a contact is deleted, disabled, or has 'Share trips' turned off in the editor. The share is therefore sent to stale ids, contacts enabled only through shareTrips are omitted, and the success toast counts share.contactIds.length, stale ids included.
evidence:
safety_controller.dart:297-303
  Future<TripShare> startShare(String rideId) async {
    final share = await _session.startShare(
      rideId,
      contactIds: preferences.tripShareContactIds.isEmpty
          ? null
          : preferences.tripShareContactIds,
safety_store.dart:257-258
    final ids = contactIds ??
        _cache.contacts.where((c) => c.shareTrips && c.isEnabled).map((c) => c.id).toList();
ride_safety_kit.dart:228-229  share.isActive && share.contactIds.isNotEmpty ? context.l10n.tripSharingStarted(share.contactIds.length)
failure_scenario: Reproduced with a throwaway test. Add contact Anna, tick her on Trip share (prefs ids [Anna]), delete Anna, then add Bo with 'Share trips' on. Safety Kit > Share trip: share.contactIds=[<Anna's deleted id>] and Bo is not included. The toast says 'Trip sharing started for 1 trusted contact.' Bo, the only real contact, never receives the trip. The same happens when a contact ticked on Trip share is later disabled or has 'Share trips' switched off in the editor: that contact still receives the ride.
suggested_fix: Derive the recipient list from the current contacts only: enabled contacts that are in the selected ids or have shareTrips. Prune ids for deleted or disabled contacts in deleteContact and updateContact. Better, keep a single source of truth for the selection.

title: Closing the Ride check card (or the Safety Kit) while Record audio is still starting leaves the microphone recording with no Stop control
description: stopIfRecording returns at once when `_active == null`. _active is set only at the end of start(), after the permission request, initDeviceAudio/initAudio and `_recorder.start` have all completed. If the rider taps Record audio and then I'm OK or Done before start() finishes, _close runs `stopIfRecording(reason: 'ride_check_closed')`, finds no active recording and returns. start() then completes and sets `_active`, and the microphone keeps recording. No card remains to stop it. On the ride summary (dropped-far card) the ride-end stop has already run, so nothing stops it. Closing the Safety Kit sheet during a pending start has the same effect (ride_safety_kit.dart:146). No in-flight start is tracked, and no busy guard covers the Record button.
failure_scenario: Reproduced with a throwaway test and a recorder whose start() is gated. open(droppedFar), call toggleRecording(), then imOk() while start is pending, then release start. Result: session=null, audio.isRecording=true, recorder still recording. The rider has answered the card, the card is gone, and the phone keeps recording audio with no indicator or Stop button.
suggested_fix: Track the in-flight start, for example a `_starting` Future or a cancelled flag. stopIfRecording should wait for it, or mark it cancelled so start() stops or cancels the recorder before it sets _active. Disable the Record button while a start is pending.

title: A Ride check the rider already answered reappears if any ride screen resumes while the close is still queued behind a slow alert
description: _close sets `_session = null` immediately, but the final submit that marks the event `resolved` is only enqueued, behind any alert POST still in flight (_enqueue serialises writes). Until that job runs, the saved event stays `acknowledged`; the red-row alert submit set that status before awaiting the network. resume(rideId) runs from every RideCheckLayer initState or didUpdateWidget, for example when RideCompleted mounts. It sees `_session == null`, asks unanswered(), which returns any event that is not resolved or stale, and rebuilds the card. resume does not consult `_shown` or anything that records a just-closed check. When the queued close finally runs, nothing closes the resurrected session.
failure_scenario: Reproduced with a throwaway test. Open a long-stop card and hold POST /ridecheck/answers. chooseRow(unsafe) starts the alert, then done() leaves session=null, then resume('r2') leaves the session open again. After the held request is released and the queue settles, the session is still open. On a slow or offline network the rider who answered 'I feel unsafe' and tapped Done sees the card come back on the next ride screen and must answer again. Back is blocked until they do.
suggested_fix: Mark the event resolved locally and synchronously in _close, before enqueuing the network work. Alternatively, keep a set of closed checkIds and make resume() skip them, or wait for settle() before it calls unanswered().

title: When a Ride check card opens, it closes the Safety Kit sheet, and the kit's dispose stops the rider's ongoing recording
description: RideCheckLayer._comeToFront pops every route above the trip screen when a card opens (ride_check_card.dart:212-217). That includes the Safety Kit sheet, a MoveraModalSheetRoute on the same navigator. The kit's dispose calls `_ctl.audio.stopIfRecording(reason: 'sheet_closed')`. A rider who started 'Record audio' in the Safety Kit because they felt unsafe has the recording stopped and finalised at the moment Ride check detects an anomaly (long stop, off route, possible crash). The card then offers 'Record audio' again as idle. The FLOW-6 rule, stop when the rider can no longer reach Stop, does not fit here: the app closed the sheet, not the rider, and the card has its own recording control.
failure_scenario: Mid-trip, the rider opens the Safety Kit and taps Record audio. The car stops off-route for 2 minutes and the long-stop card opens. The kit sheet is popped, the recording is stopped and saved, and the card shows 'Record audio · saved only on this phone' as idle. Audio of what happens next is lost unless the rider notices and starts recording again.
suggested_fix: Do not stop the recording when the sheet is closed programmatically by the Ride check layer: pass a flag, or let the card take over the active recording. Alternatively, have _comeToFront skip routes whose dispose has side effects.
