route_picker_page.dart:1097-1105 overlay only, no PopScope
home.dart:862-873  if (!mounted) return null; scheduledAt = await ScheduleDateTimeSelector.choose(context, ...)
route_change_flow.dart:107-118  final decision = await RouteChangeSheet.confirm(context, ...); final updated = await changes.apply(...)
failure_scenario: Change route on a live ride: pick a new destination, then press Android back while 'See new price' is loading. The picker closes, and a moment later the route-change price sheet appears over the ride screen. Confirming it changes the route, but the caller receives null, so the updated snapshot and refund notice are lost. On Home with Book for later, a date and time picker opens over Home after the rider backed out.
suggested_fix: Wrap the page in `PopScope(canPop: !_finishing)`, or make onFinish cancellable and check the picker route is still current before opening follow-up UI.

title: Swap throws away the known coordinates of the booked destination and stops, so Change route re-geocodes them from text
description: RoutePickerPage never receives the destination's point (`_destinationPoint` starts null), and stops never carry points. `RouteChangeController.preview` makes up for this by matching text: it uses `ride.destination*` when the destination text equals `ride.destinationAddress`, and a stop's coordinates when the text matches an entry in `ride.stops`. After `_swap` that matching fails. With stops, the old destination moves into the last stop (it is not in `ride.stops`), and the old stop becomes the destination (it is not equal to `ride.destinationAddress`). Without stops, the pickup becomes the old destination text with `_destinationPoint == null`. Every one of these is sent to `_locate(address)` instead of using the exact booked coordinates.
evidence:
route_picker_page.dart:319-325  last.text = _destination.text; _destination.text = lastText; _destinationPoint = null;
route_picker_page.dart:333-336  _pickupPoint = _destinationPoint;  // null for a prefilled destination
route_change_controller.dart:172-174  destination == ride.destinationAddress ? GeoPoint(ride.destinationLat, ...) : destinationPoint ?? await _locate(destination)
route_change_controller.dart:179-183  known = ride.stops.where((s) => s.address == address) ... ?? await _locate(address)
failure_scenario: A live ride's destination was set by map pin, so its label is a street near the pin or 'Dropped pin · 59.32930° N ...', with exact coordinates. It has one stop. The rider taps the stop/destination swap: the old destination's label is forward-geocoded to a different point (in the demo, any unknown text gets a made-up hashed point), or is not found at all. The re-quote and the driver's route then use the wrong points.
suggested_fix: Accept and track per-field points in the picker, including an initial destinationPoint and stop points, and swap them along with the text. Pass stopPoints to preview.

title: Prefix dedupe hides real suggestions, such as 'Kungsgatan 4' whenever 'Kungsgatan 44' is a recent
description: A suggestion is dropped when any matching recent address starts with the suggestion's title. That is a plain string prefix test, so a different house number or a longer place name with the same start counts as the same place. The rider then cannot pick the address they typed from the list. Pressing Enter still picks the hidden `_results.first`.
failure_scenario: Recents contain 'Kungsgatan 44, Stockholm'. The rider types 'Kungsgatan 4'. The suggestion titled 'Kungsgatan 4' is hidden because the recent starts with 'Kungsgatan 4', and the list offers only the recent 'Kungsgatan 44' (or 'No address found' tooling around it).
suggested_fix: Compare whole normalized addresses (or the title against the recent's first comma part) for equality instead of startsWith.

title: Custom saved places appear in Where to? under their type label ('Other'), not the name the rider gave them
description: Saved Places stores a place created via 'Add another' with the rider's name as its title and a slug of that name as its type (`AddPlace._kindFor`), for example 'Mamma' becomes type 'mamma'. The Home card shows `place.title`, but the route picker labels each custom place with `placeLabelFor(place.type)`, which maps every unknown type to `placeOther`. Several named places all read 'Other' and can only be told apart by address.
evidence:
route_picker_page.dart:866  title: Text(placeLabelFor(place.type), style: _t(16)),
saved_places_row.dart:167-168  default: return L10n.current.placeOther;
saved_places_row.dart:240 (Home card)  text: place.title,
add_place.dart:410-413  slug of the name becomes the kind
failure_scenario: In Saved Places, add 'Mamma' and 'Office Kista' (types 'mamma' and 'office-kista'). Open Where to?: both rows are titled 'Other'.
suggested_fix: Show place.title, falling back to placeLabelFor(type) only when the title is empty or equals the raw type key.

title: A failed autocomplete request is shown as 'No address found'
description: `suggest` catches every error (offline, timeout, 5xx, 401) and returns an empty list. RoutePickerPage cannot tell that apart from a real empty result, so `_whileTyping` shows 'No address found' with the noAddressFoundBody copy and a map button. The rider is told the address does not exist when the lookup never ran. The saved-place picker does the same: `_submitQuery` turns a thrown geocode into 'spAddressNotFound' (pickup_location.dart:70-80).
failure_scenario: With a dropped connection, the rider types a valid street. The spinner stops and 'No address found' appears for every query, with no hint that it is a connection problem or that retrying would help.
suggested_fix: Return a result type that separates failure from empty, and show a connection or retry message on failure.

title: Route picker sends an autocomplete request on every keystroke (no debounce)
description: `_onTyped` calls `destinationSearch.suggest` directly on every change, and `suggest` posts to `/api/v1/locations/autocomplete` each time. Only the response is filtered by generation, not the request. The same controller's `type()` path uses the 320 ms debounced `PlaceSearchService`, but the main Where to? field bypasses it. Typing a 20-character address sends about 20 geocoding requests, which costs quota and invites rate limiting on the live backend.
failure_scenario: Typing 'Drottninggatan 53' fires 17 POSTs to the autocomplete endpoint in under 2 seconds. Under a per-user rate limit, later requests fail and the list shows 'No address found' (see the previous finding).
suggested_fix: Debounce suggest (for example reuse PlaceSearchService) and cancel or skip superseded requests before sending.

title: Compact-to-full address map is keyed by the short label, so two fields with the same short form expand to the same full address
description: `_show` records `_fullAddress[short] = full` for every address it shortens, and `_expand` looks the field text up by that short key. `compactAddress` keeps only the first part and the last town, so different addresses such as 'Kyrkvägen 2, Bromma, Stockholm' and 'Kyrkvägen 2, Hägersten, Stockholm' both become 'Kyrkvägen 2, Stockholm'. Whichever was shown last wins, and `_finish` sends that full address for both pickup and destination. When the pickup has no point (a recent, Home or Work row), Home geocodes the wrong full address.
failure_scenario: The rider picks recent 'Kyrkvägen 2, Bromma, Stockholm' as pickup (no point), then 'Kyrkvägen 2, Hägersten, Stockholm' as destination. Both fields read 'Kyrkvägen 2, Stockholm'. The selection's pickup expands to the Hägersten address and is geocoded there, so pickup and destination become the same point.
suggested_fix: Keep the full address per field (pickup, destination, each stop) rather than in a map keyed by display text.

title: Your month card has no load generation, so an older history read can overwrite a newer one
description: `_load` runs on every history-store change and every ReservationController notification, plus once at start. Each call awaits `defaultRides()` (in release a server trip list, see ARCHITECTURE), then setState with whatever it got. Nothing orders the results, so a slow read that started before a ride was archived can finish after a newer read and put the stale month back. The card stays wrong until the next change event.
failure_scenario: A reservation update starts load A. The ride completes and is archived, which starts load B. B returns first and shows 4 rides; A returns later with the pre-archive list and shows 3. Home shows 3 rides this month until something else changes.
suggested_fix: Increment a generation counter per _load and ignore results from superseded calls.

title: Suggestion distances and the CO2 figure always use '.' as the decimal separator in sv/fr
description: `formatDistanceKm` builds '1.2 km' with toStringAsFixed, and the Home month card passes `co2AvoidedKg.toStringAsFixed(1)` ('0.4') into `homeCo2Kg`. Both bypass locale number formatting, so Swedish and French riders see '1.2 km' and '0.4 kg' instead of '1,2 km' and '0,4 kg'. These are separate code sites from the known shared/formatters/money.dart issue.
evidence:
place_suggestion.dart:66-70  rounded == rounded.roundToDouble() ? '${rounded.toInt()} km' : '${rounded.toStringAsFixed(1)} km'
home_journey_section.dart:366  context.l10n.homeCo2Kg(stats.co2AvoidedKg.toStringAsFixed(1)),
failure_scenario: App language Svenska: a Where to? suggestion 1.24 km away shows '1.2 km', and the month card shows '1.2 kg' after 3 Electric rides.
suggested_fix: Format with NumberFormat for L10n's current locale (or the app's shared decimal formatter).

title: matchRange returns offsets into the case-folded string, which can be longer than the original, so the highlight is misplaced or throws
description: `foldForSearch` lowercases with `toLowerCase()`, which can change string length. On web (JS semantics), 'İ' (U+0130) becomes 'i̇', two code units. `matchRange` returns indices into the folded text, and `_highlighted` applies them to the original with `substring(start, end)`. Once the text contains such a character, the highlight shifts, and a match near the end gives `end > text.length`, a RangeError during build.
failure_scenario: A suggestion titled 'İzmir Kebab' (5+6 chars), with the rider typing 'kebab': folded index 7, end 12, but the original length is 11, so substring throws RangeError and the results list shows an error widget (or a grey box in release).
suggested_fix: Fold character by character while keeping a map from folded index to original index, or clamp and validate the range before calling substring.

title: Address search is not blocked while 'CURRENT' is resolving, so both lookups can pop the picker
description: `_useCurrentLocation` bails out if `_searching`, but `_submitQuery` only checks `_searching`, and the search button is enabled while `_locating`. Both operations end with `Navigator.maybePop(context, address)`. Whichever finishes first decides the saved address, which can be the current position even though the rider typed and submitted an address afterwards. If the second one finishes during the ~300 ms exit transition, `mounted` is still true, and `maybePop` pops the next route, AddPlace, with a String result for a `Navigator.push<PlaceShortcut>` route.
evidence:
pickup_location.dart:62-64  if (text.isEmpty || _searching) return;   // no _locating check
pickup_location.dart:92  if (_locating || _searching) return;
pickup_location.dart:86 / 111  Navigator.maybePop(context, ...)
add_place.dart:320  Navigator.push<String>(... RiderSearchPickupLocation ...)
saved_places.dart:58  Navigator.push<PlaceShortcut>(... AddPlace ...)
failure_scenario: The rider taps CURRENT (a slow GPS fix), then types 'Odenplan' and taps search. If the GPS address arrives first, it is returned and the typed address is ignored. If both arrive within the exit animation, AddPlace is popped as well, losing the form, and a String is handed to a PlaceShortcut route.
suggested_fix: Make the two actions mutually exclusive (check `_locating` in `_submitQuery` and disable search while locating), and guard against a second pop with a 'done' flag.

title: Picker's initial hydrate has no error handling: failures become unhandled async errors and saved Home/Work show 'Not saved yet'
description: `_places.hydrate().then(...)` has no catchError, so a storage read failure is an unhandled Future error. The Saved Places screen catches the same failure explicitly (FLOW-15). The chips then show the 'Not saved yet' fallback even when Home or Work exist. Because this picker is only opened from AddPlace with `allowCreateShortcut: false`, tapping those chips does nothing, with no error shown.
failure_scenario: Storage is blocked (Safari private mode or cleared site data), so PreferencesStore.load throws. Open Add place › location: an uncaught async error is logged, and Home/Work read 'Not saved yet' and do nothing when tapped.
suggested_fix: Catch the error, log it, and show the load-failed state (or hide the chips).

title: Change route shows 'Set your Home/Work' rows that do nothing when tapped
description: RoutePickerPage always renders Home and Work rows. When the address is unset, the row is styled as an action ('routeSetFavourite' in accent colour) and calls `widget.onSetFavourite`. The live-ride Change route flow passes `onSetFavourite: (_) async => null`, so tapping the row returns null and `_setFavourite` returns silently.
failure_scenario: A rider with no saved Work opens Change route during a ride and taps 'Set your Work': nothing happens, with no sheet and no message.
suggested_fix: Hide the set-favourite rows when no handler is available (make onSetFavourite nullable), or wire it to the address sheet.

title: save() reports failure after the place was already written, so a retry adds a duplicate custom place
description: `save` awaits `_store.save(...)` and then `hydrate()`. If the re-read throws after a successful write, the exception reaches AddPlace, which shows spSaveFailed and re-enables Save. A new custom place has no id (`widget.initial?.id` is null), so the retry generates another `place_<id>` and stores a second copy. The rider was told the first save failed.
failure_scenario: Storage write succeeds, the following read fails (for example quota or eviction on web). The rider sees 'Could not save', taps Save again, and Saved Places now lists the place twice.
suggested_fix: Return the saved place even if the refresh fails (catch and log hydrate errors separately), or keep the generated id in AddPlace state so a retry updates the same entry.
